translit: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn, wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā Nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn. Rabbi shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī wa ḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī. Allāhumma ʿallimnā mā yanfaʿunā wanfaʿnā bimā ʿallamtanā wa zidnā ʿilmā.

text: [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]], we will pick up from where we left off last week.
Last week, we spoke about the marriage of [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ to [[Khadijah bint Khuwaylid|خَدِيجَة بنت خُوَيْلِد]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].
And this was a blessed marriage.
And it was a beautiful marriage that we still take lessons from today.
Any couple who wants to know how to live a happily married life should look at the marriage between [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ and [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].
There are no accounts at all during the 25 years that they were married,
there are no accounts at all of any type of arguments that they had, or any type of dispute, or any type of fighting, no account whatsoever.
So they had a very, very beautiful married life where they both respected each other, and they showed each other mutual love and compassion as husbands and wives should do.

So it was a beautiful marriage, and [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], she has a special place even amongst the wives of the Prophet ﷺ. And all of them, all of the wives of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ are [[Ummahat al-Mu'minin|أمهات المؤمنين]].
They are our mothers. They are the mothers of the believers, as Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] Himself has declared them as such.
النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ
translit: An-nabiyyu awlā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa azwājuhū ummahātuhum

text: The Prophet is closer to the believers than themselves, and his wives are their mothers. So all of the wives of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ are our mothers.
And they all deserve our honor and our respect. But even amongst the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], she has a special standing.
She was the first wife of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ. He was married to her for the longest time, for longer than he was married to any of his other wives.
While he was married to her, he didn't marry any other woman. During the time he was married to her, she was his only wife.
And these are blessings that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] gave to [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].
And even after she passed away, the Prophet ﷺ was very sad upon her passing. And even after she passed away, he continued to honor her, and he continued to show his love for her

by making sure that he kept in contact with her friends. Whenever he would sacrifice a sheep, he would make sure that some portion of that meat, it goes to the friends of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]]. This is how he remembered her even after she had passed away.

One time, the sister of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], her name was [[Halah bint Khuwaylid|هالة بنت خويلد]], and the way that she would ask permission to enter the home was similar to the way of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].

You know how sometimes siblings, they have a similar way of speaking and a similar way of doing things, so [[Halah bint Khuwaylid|هالة بنت خويلد]] had a similar way of asking permission to enter the home as [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]] used to have.

So one time [[Halah bint Khuwaylid|هالة بنت خويلد]] came to the house of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ. And this was much later, a long time after [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]] had passed away, and the Prophet ﷺ was in [[Madinah|مدينة]] now, and he was with [[A'ishah|عائشة]] at this time.

And [[Halah bint Khuwaylid|هالة بنت خويلد]], the sister of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], she came to the house of the Prophet ﷺ and asked for permission to enter the house. And the way that she asked for this permission, it reminded [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].

So when he heard it, when he heard her, he said, "[[Allahumma Halah|اللهم هالة]], [[Allahumma Halah|اللهم هالة]]"—"O Allah, let it be [[Halah|هالة]], let it be [[Halah|هالة]]." He wanted it to be the sister of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]].

And [[A'ishah|عائشة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], she's witnessing this happening, and she felt a little jealous. And of course, it's natural. This jealousy is natural, and it's nothing to be blamed about. So she felt this jealousy, and she said

to [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, "[[Ya|يَا]] [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]], why do you constantly remember this old woman when Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] has replaced her with someone who is better than her?" She's talking about herself.
And the Prophet ﷺ upon hearing this, his face changed.
His face changed, and he said, "[[Wallahi ma abdalanillahu khayran minha|والله ما أبدلني الله خيرا منها]]"—"I swear by Allah that Allah did not replace her with better than her.
[[Amanat bi hina kafaran-nas|آمنت بي حين كفر الناس]]. She believed in me when the people, they disbelieved.
[[Wa saddaqatni idh kadhdhabaniyan-nas|وصدقتني إذ كذبني الناس]]. And she believed in my truthfulness when the people were calling me a liar.
[[Wa wasatni bi-maliha|وواستني بمالها]]. And she supported me with her wealth.

[[Wa razaqaniyallahu minhal-walada duna ghayriha minan-nisa'|ورزقني منها الله الولد دون غيرها من النساء]]. And Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] gave me children through her, unlike the other wives, unlike the other wives of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ."
So this is the position of [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]] with the Messenger ﷺ.
And as he mentioned, she is the only wife that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] provided children to [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ through her. Later on,
the Prophet ﷺ also had a son, [[Ibrahim|إبراهيم]], from [[Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah|مارية القبطية]],
but [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]] was the mother of six of his children.

He had two sons and four daughters with [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]]. His son, his first son, his name was [[al-Qasim|القاسم]], and that is where [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ gets his [[kunyah|كُنية]], his title [[Abu al-Qasim|أبو القاسم]], the father of [[al-Qasim|القاسم]], because his first son was named [[al-Qasim|القاسم]].

And the Prophet ﷺ said that we can name our children with his name, meaning you can name your child [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]], you can take the name [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]], but do not take the [[kunyah|كُنية]] of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.

Do not call yourself [[Abu al-Qasim|أبو القاسم]]. You can name your son [[Qasim|قاسم]], no problem, but you don't take the [[kunyah|كُنية]] [[Abu al-Qasim|أبو القاسم]]. This is reserved for [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ. When you say [[Abu al-Qasim|أبو القاسم]], it means [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.

So we can call ourselves [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]], we can name ourselves or our children [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]], that's fine, but you do not take the [[kunyah|كُنية]] of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, you do not call yourself [[Abu al-Qasim|أبو القاسم]]. This is restricted for [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
So his first son, that was [[al-Qasim|القاسم]]. Then he had another son with [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]], and his name was [[Abdullah|عبد الله]].
And [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] also had some nicknames. He was also known as [[al-Tayyib|الطَّيِّب]] and [[al-Tahir|الطَّاهِر]]. His nicknames were [[al-Tayyib|الطَّيِّب]] and [[al-Tahir|الطَّاهِر]].

[[al-Tayyib|الطَّيِّب]] means the good one, and [[al-Tahir|الطَّاهِر]], it means the pure one. And some people, they make the mistake, they say [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, his sons were [[al-Qasim|القاسم]] and [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] and [[al-Tayyib|الطَّيِّب]] and [[al-Tahir|الطَّاهِر]]. No, this is not correct.

[[Abdullah|عبد الله]] was [[al-Tayyib|الطَّيِّب]], [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] was [[al-Tahir|الطَّاهِر]]. These were just nicknames. So it was [[al-Qasim|القاسم]] and [[Abdullah|عبد الله]]. These were his two sons with [[Khadijah|خَدِيجَة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا]]. And he had four daughters as well through that marriage.

And those daughters were [[Ruqayyah|رقية]] and [[Zaynab|زينب]] and [[Umm Kulthum|أم كلثوم]] and [[Fatimah|فاطمة]] [[radiyallahu 'anhunna|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُنَّ]]. Four daughters of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ: [[Ruqayyah|رقية]], [[Zaynab|زينب]], [[Umm Kulthum|أم كلثوم]], and [[Fatimah|فاطمة]] [[radiyallahu 'anhunna|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُنَّ]].
Six children through this marriage, a blessed marriage. And the Prophet ﷺ said
that many men have achieved [[kamal|كمال]], have achieved perfection, and of course he's talking about the Prophets of Allah,

but out of the women, only four women achieved perfection. And of course these four women who achieved perfection, they are not prophets, because all of the prophets are men. But these four women reached a station unlike any other woman. There were many men who reached a station...
